description: This file declares functions, macros, and includes for interfacing with the SST25xx flash memory device driver within an AUTOSAR-based project. It defines initialization, erase, write, read, and status functions, along with version information and configuration parameters.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SST25xx flash driver with the provided configuration.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Erase
methods.description: Erases specified sector(s) in the flash memory at the target address with given length.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Write
methods.description: Writes data to the flash memory at the specified target address.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Read
methods.description: Reads data from the flash memory from the specified source address.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_GetStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the flash memory interface.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_GetJobResult
methods.description: Returns the result of the last flash job operation.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_MainFunction
methods.description: Main function to manage ongoing flash operations.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_Compare
methods.description: Compares data at a given source address with source data for integrity check.

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of the flash driver (e.g., normal or low power).

methods.name: Fls_SST25xx_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Provides versioning information about the flash driver.
